kebab_example: aliyun ens describe-snapshots --ens-region-id cn-hangzhou --disk-id d-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --snapshot-id sp-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --ens-region-ids '["cn-suzhou-telecom","cn-chengdu-telecom"]' --snapshot-name testSnapshotName --instance-id i-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSnapshots

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ENS node. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2637662.html to query ENS node IDs
parameters.name: ens_region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud disk
parameters.name: disk_id

parameters.help_en: A single snapshot ID, or a JSON array containing up to 100 snapshot IDs
parameters.help_zh: 快照标识编码。取值可以由多个快照ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: snapshot_id

parameters.help_en: A JSON array that contains 1 to 100 ENS node IDs
parameters.name: ens_region_ids

parameters.help_en: The display name of the snapshot. The name must be 2 to 128 characters long. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot begin with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 快照的显示名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: snapshot_name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数
parameters.name: page_size

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the snapshot was created. The time is displayed in UTC and is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format
CreationTime.description_zh: 创建时间。按照[ISO8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html）标准表示，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss

EnsRegionId.description_en: The ID of the Edge Node Service (ENS) node

Size.description_en: The capacity of the disk. Unit: MiB

SnapshotName.description_en: The name of the snapshot. This parameter is returned only if a name was specified when the snapshot was created
SnapshotName.description_zh: 快照显示名称。如果创建时指定了快照显示名称，则返回

SourceDiskCategory.description_en:
The category of the disk. Valid values:

cloud_efficiency: ultra disk.

cloud_ssd: standard SSD.

local_hdd: local HDD.

local_ssd: local SSD
SourceDiskCategory.description_zh:
磁盘类型。取值：

cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。
cloud_ssd：全闪云盘。
local_hdd：本地HDD盘。
local_ssd：本地盘SSD

SourceDiskId.description_en: The ID of the source disk. This parameter is retained even after the source disk is released
SourceDiskId.description_zh: 源云盘ID。如果快照的源云盘已经被释放，该字段仍旧保留

SourceDiskType.description_en:
The attribute of the disk. Valid values:

1: system disk.

2: data disk
SourceDiskType.description_zh:
磁盘属性。取值：

1：系统盘。
2：数据盘

SourceEnsRegionId.description_en: The ID of the source ENS node

SourceSnapshotId.description_en: The ID of the source snapshot

Status.description_en:
The status of the snapshot. Valid values:

creating: The snapshot is being created.

available: The snapshot is available.

deleting: The snapshot is being deleted.

error: The snapshot fails to be created
Status.description_zh:
快照状态。取值：

creating：创建中。
available：可用。
deleting：删除中。
error：错误
